### Corrections

#### Row {.tabset}

##### Page 606 in the «FPP on IHRG» paper

:::{.callout-note collapse="true" title="Lemma 4.2."}

$$
\begin{align*}
\mathrm{P} \left( 
  {\arg \min}_i \{ C_n^i = C_n^{\text{con}} \}
  > k
\right)
\leq
\left( \frac{\tilde \lambda}{\tilde \lambda + 1} \right) ^ k
\end{align*}
$$

:::

:::{.callout-note collapse="true" title="Equation 4.3."}

$$
\begin{align*}
\frac{a_n C_n^{\text{con}}}{n}
\leq
\sum_{i=1}^{N \sim \text{Geometric} \left( \frac{1}{\tilde \lambda + 1}
\right)}
  \tilde E_i \sim \text{Exp} \left (
    \tilde \lambda \sum_{s \in \mathcal S} \frac{\pi_s^2}{\mu_s}
  \right)
\end{align*}
$$



:::


:::{.callout-important collapse="false" title="Correction of page 606"}

$$
\begin{align*}
&\frac{\ln C_n^{\text{con}}}{\ln n}
&& = \frac
      {\ln \frac{a_n C_n^{\text{con}}}{n} + 
       \ln \frac{n}{a_n}}
      {\ln n} \\
&&& = \frac{\ln \frac{a_n C_n^{\text{con}}}{n}}{\ln n} + 
    \frac{\ln \frac{n}{a_n}}{\ln n} \\
& \frac{\ln \frac{n}{a_n}}{\ln n}
&& = \frac{\ln \frac{n}{\sqrt n}}{\ln n} \\
&&& = \frac{\ln \sqrt n}{\ln n} \\
&&& = \frac{1}{2} \quad (\ast) \\
& \frac{\ln \frac{a_n C_n^{\text{con}}}{n}}{\ln n}
&& \stackrel{(4.3)}{\leq} 
  \frac{\ln \left[ \sum_{i=1}^N \tilde E_i \right]}{\ln n}
& N \sim \text{Geometric} \left( \frac{1}{\tilde \lambda + 1} \right) , \quad \tilde E_i \stackrel{i.i.d}\sim \text{Exp} \left( \hat \lambda  \right) \\
&&& = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^N \ln \tilde E_i}{\ln n} \\
&&& \xrightarrow[n \to \infty]{\text{a.s.}} 0 \quad (\ast \ast) \\
& (\ast) \text{ and } (\ast \ast)
&& \implies \frac{\ln C_n^{\text{con}}}{\ln n} \xrightarrow[n \to \infty]{\text{a.s.}} \frac{1}{2}.
\end{align*}
$$

Conclusion: there is indeed a typo in page 606, where it should instead read:

$$
\mathcal N \left(0, \frac{\ln a_n}{\ln n} \right) + 
\mathcal N \left(0, \frac{\ln C_n^{\text{con}}}{\ln n} \right)
\to \mathcal N(0, 1).
$$

:::
